analysis: This PR contains only documentation and changelog changes. changelog.d/1394-watchdog-launch-recovery.md is a new fragment describing watchdog launch-receipt recovery after interrupted launches. It also says unproven launch intent is preserved across health observations, and that a failed-start timeout needs comparable launch evidence. docs/developer/build.md bumps the freshness date and adds a paragraph (patch hunk at new line ~667) on building CPU-only watchdog launch-evidence tests with `swift build --build-tests --jobs 2 --force-resolved-versions`, retaining source and dependency revisions, and requiring `--skip-build` to use that exact product. No executable code, configuration, or trust-boundary behavior is changed here. The watchdog logic itself (T-043, TB-003) is not part of the supplied diff, so the described behavior is unverified. A reviewer of the Swift watchdog source should confirm that recovered launch receipts cannot be forged by the operator to suppress rollback, and that missing evidence does not mask a failed candidate. No new attack surface, and no assumption in the threat model is invalidated by these docs. Coverage limit: the build.md base text excerpt was displayed in two units and the changed hunk was reviewed in full from the patch.
